name: rankability
description: AI search visibility and SEO for businesses, marketing teams and agencies: see where ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and other answer engines mention or skip your brand or clients, close the citation gaps, and create, audit and report on content.

interface.longDescription: Rankability brings your SEO and AI search data into your conversations. See how often AI answers mention and cite your clients, track organic rankings and local pack positions, and find which competitors and domains AI answers cite instead. Check any brand live across major AI answer engines and search engines, run on-page SEO audits against a target keyword, do keyword research, review site audits and Search Console performance, and build content briefs and SEO and AEO content. Built for businesses, marketing teams, consultants and agencies working on AEO, GEO, rank tracking and content optimization. Actions that use account usage ask for your approval first, and access stays within the organization you connect.
defaultPrompt: Are AI answers citing my client’s site? Show where competitors win.
Audit this page for my target keyword and tell me what to fix.
Find keywords my client should target next.
